cat > programs/task-3de64de1.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    width = len(grid[0])
    height = width
    center = next(c for c, value in enumerate(grid[0]) if value == 2)
    out = [[0] * width for _ in range(height)]
    for r in range(height):
        left, right = center - r, center + r
        for c in (left, right):
            if 0 <= c < width:
                out[r][c] = 2
        for c in range(width):
            if left < c < right and (c - r - center) % 4 == 0 and out[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = 1
    return out
PY
